test_scenario_name: Valid input - fault triggered - genuine recovery
classification_rationale: Fault triggered in intermediate stage; monitor re-executed and restored valid state; API returned SUCCESS and output matched valid secret.
Normal decapsulation without fault; API returned SUCCESS and output matched valid secret.

test_scenario_name: Valid input - persistent fault - safe fail-stop
classification_rationale: Recurring fault triggered; monitor aborted to fail-stop; API returned 0xFFFFFFFF and emitted conformant rejection key. Output not accepted as success.

test_scenario_name: Valid input - fault triggered - SDC accepted
classification_rationale: Silent Data Corruption: API returned SUCCESS but emitted shared secret did not match authentic valid secret.

test_scenario_name: Valid input - fail-stop with nonstandard buffer
classification_rationale: Safe fail-stop signaled via API error code (0xFFFFFFFF) but fallback buffer did not match clean-room rejection key. Caller rejects operation; H2=0.
FIPS 203 implicit rejection: invalid ciphertext decapsulated; output matches J(z||c) with standard rejection status. Not SDC.

test_scenario_name: Invalid input - false bypass encapsulation SDC
classification_rationale: Critical security failure: invalid ciphertext was accepted and emitted the valid shared secret (bypassing re-encryption check).

test_scenario_name: Invalid input - fault triggered - safe fail-stop
classification_rationale: Invalid ciphertext encountered during faulted execution; monitor aborted to fail-stop. Caller rejects; H2=0.
Oracle ground-truth hash is missing or corrupted; cannot determine correctness. Classified as inconclusive.
Contradictory telemetry: API signals fail-stop error but output buffer matches valid key. Classified as inconclusive.
